title: shared/web-shared query-client: import the QueryClient through the local re-export, not the @mlflow/mlflow alias
answers: Why does the shared web-shared notebook renderer import from a relative path instead of @mlflow/mlflow?
Where should a new web-shared component get its QueryClient from?
Can code under shared/web-shared import from src/common through the alias?
body:
Path: shared/web-shared/query-client/queryClient.ts re-exports QueryClient, QueryClientProvider and onlineManager from common/utils/reactQueryHooks, and createMlflowQueryClient.ts imports QueryClient from that local file. The notebook renderer (oss-notebook-renderer/bootstrap.tsx) reaches the factory through a relative import.
Rule: Code under shared/web-shared/ should stay self-contained and import its query client through the local ./queryClient or relative paths, not through @mlflow/mlflow/src/common/... aliases. The app shell (src/app.tsx) is outside web-shared and keeps using the alias to import the factory.
Symptom: Not a user-visible symptom; the rule keeps the shared package portable across entry points.
Constraints: Applies to files under shared/web-shared/. Outside web-shared, aliased imports are fine.
applies: Imports within mlflow/server/js/src/shared/web-shared; other packages are not covered.
says: Make shared notebook interface components reusable across different web entry points.
Ensure embedded notebook visualization widgets remain self-contained without external application dependencies.
search: Code within mlflow/server/js/src/shared/web-shared must import QueryClient locally through ./queryClient or relative paths rather than the @mlflow/mlflow/src/common alias. This maintains portability across entry points such as the notebook renderer in oss-notebook-renderer/bootstrap.tsx, whereas the outer app shell in src/app.tsx may still use aliased imports.
